description:
[Merchant] List a product's placements. A placement is one way the product is distributed - a poster, a TV spot, a packaging label - with its own ID (pl + 8 characters), so every payment it starts is attributed to it.

**Endpoint:** GET /products/{productId}/placements

Changing anything here needs the PRM plan, and below it a change answers 403 ERR_UNAUTHORIZED_OPERATION; reading works on every plan, results only on PRM. A merchant that leaves PRM keeps its placements read-only, and a printed placement code then pays as its plain product with no attribution.

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_list_placements
